TimeRange.title: TimeRange

description: A data request for one dataset, one geohash cell and an optional time range.

driver.description: Data source: 'openeo' (collections of the openEO back-end in the config, default CDSE), 'cdse_federation' (collections of the CDSE openEO Federation: CDSE + Terrascope), 'stac' (any STAC collection, loaded with openEO load_stac), 'edh' (Earth Data Hub Zarr), 'tessera' (TESSERA embeddings via geotessera), 'local' (Zarr/NetCDF/GeoTIFF on disk).
driver.title: Driver

dataset.description: openeo / cdse_federation: collection id (e.g. SENTINEL2_L2A); stac: STAC collection URL; edh: dataset path (e.g. era5/era5-single-levels-atmosphere-v0) or full URL; tessera: store version (e.g. v1.1) or store URL; local: path to the store/file.
dataset.title: Dataset

variables.description: Bands / variables to retrieve, e.g. ['B04', 'B08'] or ['t2m'].
variables.title: Variables

geohash.description: Area of interest as a geohash cell, e.g. 'qem7'.
geohash.title: Geohash

time.description: Days to retrieve (inclusive); null for static datasets.

target_dir.description: Local directory where the NetCDF output is written.
target_dir.title: Target Dir

options.description: Driver-specific extras, e.g. {'max_cloud_cover': 60} for openeo, cdse_federation and stac; {'bands': [0, 1, 2]} for tessera.
options.title: Options
